statistical_claims: Across 1 analyzable contrast(s), 1 produced significant differential expression accompanied by functional pathway enrichment, indicating a coordinated transcriptional response.

Across 6 sample- or donor-matched biological units profiled in both assays, 142463 cis peak-gene pair(s) within 100000 bp of the TSS were tested and 8 showed a significant across-sample correlation between accessibility and expression (7 positive, 1 negative). Top linked genes include LINC01480, MAP2K3, and HLA-DRB1.
Approximate bulk RNA power ranged from 29% to 29% across analyzable contrasts.
Bulk ATAC DESeq2 differential accessibility ran 1 comparison(s) over 6 replicate samples and found 13706 differentially accessible peaks.
Bulk ATAC QC measured 6 sample(s) with mean mitochondrial fraction 0.0.
Bulk ATAC peak counting produced a matrix with 47022 peaks across 6 samples.
Bulk RNA sample QC evaluated 6 samples with 0 outlier(s) flagged; primary DE retained all samples and sensitivity removed 0.
Bulk contrast K562 vs GM12878 had 1833 DE genes.

For K562_vs_GM12878, 18 enriched biological term(s) were shared between the 69 RNA enriched term(s) and the 69 enriched term(s) of genes near differentially accessible peaks (Jaccard index 0.15). Shared terms include Allograft rejection, Autoimmune thyroid disease, and Cell adhesion molecules.

For K562_vs_GM12878, DE×DA cis concordance over 16973 co-tested gene-peak pair(s) found 2465 sign-concordant (1208 up, 1257 down) and 491 sign-discordant co-significant pair(s), while 2587 pair(s) shifted in accessibility without an RNA change, and 4133 changed in RNA without an accessibility shift. RNA and ATAC log2 fold changes across co-tested pairs gave Spearman r = 0.38, p = 0; the directional Fisher test gave an odds ratio of 25.2 (p = 1.7e-314). Top concordant genes include CCR7, HLA-DPA1, and SERPINB6.

For K562_vs_GM12878, TF motif or footprint shifts in chromatin were compared with each TF's own RNA change across 44 evaluated TF(s): 5 were sign-concordant, 3 sign-discordant, and 5 showed a chromatin shift without an RNA change. Concordant TFs include Arid3a, HOXB4, and Dlx4. 44 evaluated TF motif(s) are shared with paralog family members, so the specific TF behind each motif signal is ambiguous and the concordance is associative.
Functional ORA (local_hypergeometric) of genes near bulk ATAC differentially accessible peaks found 79 enriched term(s) across 5 database(s).
Genomic annotation classified 13706 bulk ATAC differentially accessible peak(s) by feature; 1996 (15%) fall in promoter regions.
MACS3 peak calling for bulk ATAC identified 87078 peaks.
Pathway enrichment found 80 term(s) for K562 vs GM12878.
Preranked GSEA generated ranked pathway support for K562 vs GM12878.
TF motif enrichment (JASPAR2024_CORE_vertebrates, hypergeometric) tested 879 motifs and found enriched motifs in 2 of 2 peak group(s).

These integrated results are associative and do not establish causality or direct regulation; cross-analysis agreement prioritizes candidates for independent experimental validation rather than proving a mechanism. Approximate statistical power ranged from 0.289 to 0.289 across contrasts.

This cross-modal synthesis compares bulk_RNA and bulk_ATAC measured in separate libraries or unpaired cohorts rather than in the same cells, so agreement reflects condition- or donor-level co-variation and is associative; it does not establish single-cell cis coupling or a mechanism.
